description: Agent Memory: submit a deletion flow: every place the memory lives (the primary store, a backup, a summary, a profile, an embedding index, a cache, a log, a copy shared elsewhere or other) with what a removal request does there (deletes it, marks it deleted but keeps it, or leaves it), how long it takes and whether a restore from backup can bring it back, the confirmation the principal gets (whether one is sent, whether it names each place cleared and how they can check it: a deletion receipt, an export showing nothing remains, a view of what is kept, or no way), how long deletion may take in all, and optionally the removal requests seen with when each was confirmed and whether the memory was found again afterward. The signed report says place by place whether a removal request clears the memory everywhere it lives, backups and derived summaries and profiles included, and whether the principal gets a confirmation they can check, and names every place the request leaves, every derived copy that survives, every restore that can bring memory back, every memory found again after its confirmation and no confirmation, then every place that only marks memory deleted, every place slower than the stated time, a confirmation that cannot be checked or names no places and every request confirmed late, with the fix for each. This reads one removal request across the agent’s memory: a data policy’s deletion timeline as written is wever_data-retention-check, purging on a retention period is wever_memory-retention-check, switching memory off is wever_memory-consent-check and deletion or return on a processor’s termination is wever_dpa-evidence-check. Verdict deletion_incomplete, deletion_gaps, deletion_unverified or deleted_everywhere. POST /api/memory-deletion-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-memory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-memory/.

checkable.description: How the principal can check it: a deletion receipt with an id, an export showing nothing remains, a view of what is kept, or no way.

names_places.description: The confirmation names each place the memory was cleared from.

sent.description: The principal gets a confirmation when deletion is done.

flow.description: The deletion flow, such as forget-me requests.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

places.description: Every place the memory lives, including backups and anything derived from it.

kind.description: What it is: the primary store, a backup, a summary, a profile, an embedding index, a cache, a log, a copy shared elsewhere, or something else.

name.description: Where the memory lives, such as the memory store or the weekly backup.

on_request.description: What a removal request does here: deletes the memory, marks it deleted but keeps it, or leaves it.

restore_brings_back.description: A restore from a backup can bring the deleted memory back here.

within.description: How long after the request it is gone here, such as 30 days.

requests.description: Removal requests seen, with when each was confirmed.

confirmed_at.description: When the principal was told it was done.

found_after.description: The memory was found again after the confirmation, such as in a summary or after a restore.

target.description: How long deletion may take in all, such as 30 days.
